title: Dark Cloud (USA, SCUS_971.11), MWCC PS2 2.3.3 (C++)
setup: mkdir -p tools/compilers/mw && mv tools/compilers/mw/2.3.3 tools/compilers/mw/2.3.3.repo 2>/dev/null || rm -rf tools/compilers/mw/2.3.3; mkdir -p tools/compilers/mw/2.3.3 && cp {tool:mwcps2-2.3.3-000906}/mwccps2.exe tools/compilers/mw/2.3.3/mwccmips.exe && cp {tool:mwcps2-2.3.3-000906}/LMGR326B.DLL {tool:mwcps2-2.3.3-000906}/asm_r5900_elf.exe {tool:mwcps2-2.3.3-000906}/mwldps2.exe tools/compilers/mw/2.3.3/

mkdir -p rom/ntsc/extracted/iso && ln -sf {retail} rom/ntsc/extracted/iso/SCUS_971.11 && for f in TITLE.BIN DUN.BIN; do ln -sf ~/ventris-corpus/extracted/ps2-dark-cloud/modules/$f rom/ntsc/extracted/iso/$f; done
limits: C++ lane (136 game units, mangled names, classes). Candidates are C, written as `.c` files at the unit's place so the unit's own command (`scripts/build/mwccgap.sh`, MWCC 2.3.3) compiles them as C; each function carries the retail mangled symbol name. The context is the repo's own C-compatible m2c context (`ctx.c` from `scripts/build/cmake.sh ctx`), the same text for every function; no per-function `#pragma` state and no `oracle` layer.

The repo compiles through `scripts/build/statefix-wibo.sh`, a python shim that applies per-unit compiler-state fixes the sources carry as pragmas. It is switched off here with the repo's own documented `STATEFIX=0` (plain wibo, the pinned unmodified compiler), so the matched set is what plain MWCC 2.3.3 reproduces, smaller than the repo's own. The repo's `mwccmips.exe` is byte-identical to the pinned `mwccps2.exe` (sha256 6375fd27...).

romwright prints a C++ symbol demangled (`ClsMes_SetHalfFontWPercent` for `SetHalfFontWPercent__6ClsMesFf`); the harness renames the function the text defines to the retail mangled symbol (as m22-002 does for stock Ghidra's names), nothing else in the text is changed.
